name: Duke Hydraxis
summary: On a wave-battered islet off Azshara, Duke Hydraxis calls mortals to battle ancient elemental rivals. He leads the Hydraxian Waterlords in service to Neptulon the Tidehunter, with Ragnaros the Firelord his chief foe.

sections.title: Lord of the Waterlords
sections.body: Duke Hydraxis watches elemental turmoil from a rock northeast of the Ravencrest Monument in Azshara. As emissary of the Hydraxian Waterlords, he acts with purpose amid Azeroth’s hostile and chaotic elementals. He serves Neptulon the Tidehunter and holds water to be the purest and most essential primal force. Now he seeks champions to shift the balance of elemental warfare.

sections.title: The War Against Fire
sections.body:
Duke Hydraxis wages his chief campaign against the blazing hosts of Ragnaros the Firelord. He sees the advance of fiery elementals as a blight that must be extinguished.

Before he trusts mortals with the means to challenge Ragnaros’s stronghold in the Molten Core, they must prove their strength, resilience, and loyalty by slaying hostile elementals across the continents. Those who prove worthy receive the sea’s blessings and the means to douse the sacred flames guarding the Firelord’s domain.

faq.q: Where can Duke Hydraxis be found?
faq.answer: You can find Duke Hydraxis on a tiny, isolated island off Azshara’s eastern coast, directly northeast of the Ravencrest Monument.

faq.q: Who is Duke Hydraxis aligned with?
faq.answer: Duke Hydraxis leads the Hydraxian Waterlords in service to Neptulon the Tidehunter, ruler of the water elementals.

faq.q: Why is Duke Hydraxis interested in mortal champions?
faq.answer: Duke Hydraxis seeks dependable mortal allies to fight rival elemental factions, especially Ragnaros’s fiery forces in Blackrock Mountain.

faq.q: What is Duke Hydraxis's connection to the Molten Core?
faq.answer: Duke Hydraxis directs champions against Ragnaros the Firelord and gives them elemental aids to extinguish the runes and bosses guarding the Molten Core.

angles.text: As a shaman, meeting an elemental of Duke Hydraxis’s stature offers rare insight into Neptulon’s ancient hierarchy and the enduring rivalries between the elemental planes.
